name: Rene Pirrotta
title: Practice Lead | Senior Psychologist
description: Works with adults with trauma, substance-related concerns, attachment, emotional regulation and self-esteem; experience working with clients exploring their gender, sexuality, and neurodivergent identity. Focus on Schema Therapy, EMDR and DBT. Member of the International Society of the Study of Trauma and Dissociation.
specialties: trauma, gender, sexuality, schema therapy, EMDR, DBT, attachment, emotional regulation

name: Owen O'Neil
title: Senior Psychologist (Counselling Psychologist)
description: He is a proud queer poly person dedicated to working with members of queer communities. Provides individual and relationship therapy, particularly with queer, poly, and CNM relationships; special interest in complex trauma and addiction. Trauma-informed, gender-affirming, sex, kink, and sex worker positive, and neurodiversity affirming. Modalities: EFT, IFS, EMDR, ACT, Narrative Therapy.
specialties: queer, poly/CNM relationships, complex trauma, addiction, kink, sex worker positive, gender-affirming, EMDR, IFS, EFT
identity: proud queer poly person; situationally binary cisgender

name: Jhocelyn Jobe
title: Psychologist
description: Enjoys working with her fellow LGBTQIAP+ community members from a standpoint that is neurodiverse affirming and trauma informed. Applies EFT to relationship counselling, inclusive of diverse relationship structures and kink dynamics. Experience with LGBTQIAP+ exploration, trauma and attachment; conducts Adult WPATH assessments for gender affirmation.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+, kink, diverse relationships, trauma, neurodivergence, WPATH assessments, EFT, CBT

name: David Edmonds
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Draws on CBT, ACT, DBT, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) and Motivational Interviewing. Works with trauma, personality disorders, neurodiversity and more; special interest in working with individuals who also belong to the LGBTIQAP+ community and/or neurodivergent individuals.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, LGBTIQAP+, neurodiversity, DBT, ACT

name: Sophie Glynn
title: Psychologist
description: An LGBTQIA+ affirming and neuroaffirming practitioner acknowledging difficulties faced by queer and/or neurodivergent people. Supports trauma, addiction and relationship challenges, and clients exploring sexuality, gender, or neurodivergent identities. Primarily draws upon CBT, Schema Therapy, ACT and EMDR.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, queer, trauma, sexuality, gender, schema therapy, EMDR, ACT

name: Bill Darby
title: Psychologist
description: Sensitive to the experiences of LGBTIQAP+ people, people from diverse and minority backgrounds, and those experiencing challenges around anxiety, trauma, gender, sexuality, and relationships (including non-traditional relationships). Values personal lived experience.
specialties: LGBTIQAP+, trauma, gender, sexuality, non-traditional relationships

name: Serena Hillin
title: Psychologist
description: As a non-binary and neurodivergent individual, they welcome clients experiencing difficulties with their identity, mental health, or life path. Draws upon CBT, ACT, IPT, LGBTQIA+ Affirmative Therapy, Internal Family Systems Therapy (Parts Work), and Narrative Therapy. Works with ages eight to eighty.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ affirmative therapy, identity, IFS parts work, neurodivergence, narrative therapy

name: Emily Alexander
title: Psychologist (assessments only)
description: Provides autism, ADHD, cognitive and academic assessments. Especially passionate about helping neurodivergent LGBTQIAP+ folk work towards self-acceptance and authenticity.

name: Logan Flott
title: Psychologist
description: Passionate about inclusive, trauma-informed care and supporting neurodivergent individuals and those within the LGBT+ community. Particular love for supporting individuals navigating complex trauma, eating disorders (ARFID), self-harm and psychosis. Uses DBT, IFS, CBT, mindfulness and yoga; Gottman Level 1 trained.
specialties: complex trauma, LGBT+, eating disorders, DBT, IFS, couples

name: Halo Jones
title: Psychologist
description: Halo's work is informed by a lifetime of lived experience as a queer and transgender woman. An advocate for TGD people in the family violence space; particular interest in working with TGD and neurodiverse people. Works within a CBT framework.
specialties: transgender and gender diverse (TGD), LGBTIQAP+, neurodiversity, CBT

name: Emmett Radovich
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: Emmett is a queer trans man with lived experience of neurodivergence and chronic illness. Interested in how ADHD, autism, anxiety and chronic illness intersect within individual and collective queer, trans and neurodivergent experiences and identities. Draws on ACT, CBT and interpersonal therapy.
specialties: queer, trans, neurodivergence, chronic illness, ACT, CBT

name: Lilly McCann
title: Psychologist
description: Creates a safe, collaborative, and trauma-informed space. As a queer ADHDer, Lilly brings lived experience to her practice and is committed to providing inclusive and affirming support to LGBTQIAP+ clients. Uses DBT, CBT, ACT and IFS.
specialties: LGBTQIAP+, trauma-informed, DBT, IFS, children and adolescents, PDA

name: Enzo Somosi
title: Psychologist
description: Works with OCD, anxiety, depression, trauma, personality difficulties and men's mental health. Trained in the Gottman Method and Couples Schema Therapy. Provides neuroaffirming and LGBTQIA+ inclusive care.
specialties: trauma, OCD, couples schema therapy, LGBTQIA+ inclusive, men's mental health

name: Jessie Goldie
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: Draws on ACT, CBT, DBT, and Schema Therapy. Experience with trauma, emotion regulation, disordered eating and relationship difficulties; passionate about supporting neurodivergent individuals and members of the LGBTQIAP+ community.
specialties: schema therapy, trauma, LGBTQIAP+, DBT, disordered eating
